headline: JP Morgan Strategist on AI Jitters, Investing Outlook
headline_vi: Nhà chiến lược JP Morgan về AI Jitters, triển vọng đầu tư
summary: Jordan Jackson, JPMorgan Asset Management Global Market Strategist, discusses whether earnings growth may be nearing a peak even if results are not worsening. Jackson agrees that third-quarter results are expected to be strong, with forecasts calling for about 27% to 28% year-over-year earnings grow
